lede: Next week's batch, Mon Nov 16 to Sun Nov 22: 7 evening videos (Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and 6 Pinterest video pins), 14 image pins and 2 carousels (Instagram and Facebook). Built from last week's Buffer data: 3 maze videos (the one format that broke out), fewer timer videos, a Memory Lane push, Thanksgiving and Black Friday gift pins, and 8 posts labeled as experiments. Tap a thumbnail to open the full media.

insights.data_note: Pulled from Buffer on Sat Nov 14 (2:40 AM ET): posts sent Oct 31 to Nov 14, plus aggregates for Nov 7-14 vs Oct 31-Nov 6. Posts under 24 h old (Fri Nov 13 evening) were ignored; Pinterest lags more, so the last ~8 pins (0 impressions) are ignored too. Sample sizes are tiny, so these are hints, not trends.

instagram.summary: Nov 7-14: 8 Reels, 1,762 views, 1,499 reach, avg watch 3.8 s, 18 reactions, 2 comments, 1 save (prior 7 days: 9 Reels, 685 views, 4.0 s). The Mon Nov 9 maze Reel alone had 1,241 views (70% of the total); without it the other 7 Reels averaged about 75 views, flat vs the prior week. Carousels: Buffer reports 0 views/reach for all three IG carousels, so there is no usable carousel data.
best: Mon Nov 9 maze (rectangle): 1,241 views, 8.3 s avg watch, 13 reactions. Opens straight on a clear visual task with a countdown; the only post that broke out.
Tue Nov 10 Random trivia: 121 views, 5.6 s watch, 2 comments (the only comments of the week). A score question ("What's your score out of 2?") plus 4 options held people and invited replies.
Sun Nov 1 Memory Lane Reel: 113 views, 5.4 s watch, 2 reactions, 1 comment. Nostalgia content holds attention even at low reach.
worst: Wed Nov 4 Parents timer (21 s): 49 views, 1.6 s watch. Long, text-only question card.
Tue Nov 3 maze (30 s): 54 views, 3.9 s. Old long maze format (the new 16 s version got 1,241 views).
Sat Nov 7 Memory quiz (28 s): 61 views, 1.9 s. Long video, 3 questions.

facebook.summary: Nov 7-14 (page only started Nov 5): 9 posts, 872 impressions, 820 reach, 0 reactions, 1 comment, 0 shares, 0 clicks. Per post: the first four Reels got 125-256 impressions, then Mon-Wed Nov 9-11 got only 0-2 each (carousel 2, with 1 comment), then the Thu Nov 12 Memory Reel got 268. Possible lag or Facebook throttling a new Page; too early to read.
best: Thu Nov 12 Memory Lane Reel: 268 impressions (best on Facebook; older audience fits nostalgia).
worst: Mon Nov 9 maze, Tue Nov 10 Random trivia, Wed Nov 11 Parents timer: 1 impression each, odd given the same videos did 55-1,241 views on Instagram.
Wed Nov 11 Couples multi-photo post: 2 impressions, 1 comment.
Fri Nov 6 About Me timer: 125 impressions (lowest of the early Reels).

pinterest.summary: Nov 7-14: 18 pins, 41 impressions, 0 saves, 0 clicks, 1 video view (prior 7 days: 18 pins, 72 impressions, 2 clicks, 3 views). Almost every pin gets 3-4 impressions whatever the format, book or slot (12:00, 16:00, 21:00), so there is no real signal yet. The only clicks (2) and the highest impressions went to Memory Lane pins.
best: Memory Lane 5 music questions list pin (Oct 31): 11 impressions, 1 click.
Memory Lane 5 book questions list pin (Nov 3): 9 impressions.
Memory Lane Ethel hook pin (Nov 6): 3 impressions, 1 click. Memory Lane is the only book with clicks.
worst: All video pins (Reel repeats): 0-4 impressions and 0-2 views each, 0 saves. Image pins did slightly better (3-9 impressions) but also 0 saves.
The last 8 pins (Nov 12-13) show 0 impressions, but metrics lag, so they are ignored.
pinterest.errors: Pinterest errors: 3 trivia video pins failed with "this site doesn't allow pins to be saved": Random Thu Nov 5 (w45), Memory Sat Nov 7 (w45) and Random Tue Nov 10 (w46). All image pins and the maze and timer video pins went through, as did the Memory Thu Nov 12 video pin (sent, 0 impressions). So 3 of 5 trivia video pins failed, 2 of 2 Random ones.

adjustments: DO MORE: 3 maze videos (Mon, Thu, Sun) instead of 2, shapes hexagon, square and rectangle, because mazes are the only Reel format that broke out (1,241 views, 8.3 s watch) and fit Facebook's older audience.
DO MORE: keep every video at 14-17 s with the question or maze on screen from frame 1; the short format held people about twice as long (5.0 s vs 2.5 s avg watch on 4 vs 7 Reels).

DO MORE: Memory Lane on Pinterest (4 posts: video pin, hook pin, list pin, gift pin) because it is the only book with Pinterest clicks, and nostalgia is the best-held Reel on Facebook; also put the Memory quiz video on Tuesday.

DO LESS: timer videos fall from 3 to 2 a week (Parents on Wed for Thanksgiving, About Me on Sat); they had the lowest watch time (2.2 s avg over 5 Reels). No Couples video this week (2 of the 5 timers, 1.9-2.4 s); Couples stays in pins and a carousel until Valentine's.

DO LESS: no Random Knowledge video pin this week. Both sent Random video pins errored, so Fri 9 PM becomes a Random image pin instead (still 20 pins). The Memory video pin stays as a test of whether the error is Random-only.
KEEP: 2 trivia videos stay (1 Memory Lane, 1 Random), and the end card keeps asking a real question ("What's your score out of 2?"), the only comments in the last 7 days came from that style.

Pinterest has no usable signal (3-4 impressions per pin), so the mix follows the seasonal calendar: 4 gift pins for Black Friday and Christmas (Parents, Mazes, Memory Lane), Thanksgiving pins for Parents and About Me, early Valentine's/date-night pins for Couples.
TEST (labeled experiments, 8 of 38 posts): Wed Parents video with a holiday-countdown hook; Thu maze video with a family-challenge hook; Thu first Memory Lane carousel (Instagram and Facebook).
insights.caveats: Instagram carousel metrics are not available in Buffer (0 views/reach on all three), Facebook Reels Mon-Wed Nov 9-11 look unusually low (possible metric lag), and Pinterest is too small to compare. Amazon Attribution sales were not available to this run.
